text: asked QD3-010: D3b's first batch is adjudicated: all 34,819 re-check lines of the 472 returned rooms are ruled, nothing moved, and notes-D3.md holds the before-and-after, the held proposals and a table of all 705 rooms. Your terms (QD3-009) say to close D3b when the first batch is adjudicated. But done.sh D3 runs validate.py D3 as the close-check, and it refuses the close with 233 errors, one for each room pending, second batch ('has no checked local account for the revised model'; report out/_closes/D3-D3b-20261022T051927Z.validate.txt). It has no other error. The contract (stage D3 section 5: every affected room needs a revised local account) and your term conflict until the second batch is back. How shall D3b close: (a) the harness or the handler records the close with these 233 errors accepted as the pending state; (b) I close with done.sh D3 --pause, which skips the close-check, although no .pause file is set; or (c) the leg stays open until the second batch returns and I rule it in this leg? | meanwhile: The leg stays open, as done.sh left it. I change nothing more: no ruling, no move, no scope file, no D3c. I stop here, and I take up your answer in the next packet.

done.sh D3 ran at 20261022T051927Z: close-check FAILED, the leg stays open (report out/_closes/D3-D3b-20261022T051927Z.validate.txt): 233 errors, each a room pending, second batch, without a checked local account for the revised model, and no other error; 12 warnings as noted. Asked J as QD3-010 how D3b closes under QD3-009 while the contract's close-check requires every affected room's revised account. Meanwhile, per the assumption stated in QD3-010: nothing more changes in this leg, no ruling, no move, no scope file, no D3c; I stop here and take up the answer in the next packet.

QD3-010 answered (the handler, on J's instruction; J, 22 Oct 22:04 Berlin): option 3. D3b stays open and the second batch is ruled in this leg; no --force and no --pause. The second batch is in: ingest D --recheck at 19:57Z accepted 705 rooms, rejected 0 (53,490 lines, 705 verdict lines; out/ingest-D-recheck.md). adaptations-recheck.jsonl holds 53,493 lines: 34,819 ruled, 18,674 new (the 233 rooms that were pending and a few rewritten lines). cirkeltrek was rewritten by its labeler after the first compile, and its 3 superseded lines stand beside the new ones: its before and after are read, and its new lines ruled. The held proposals are now judged on all 705 rooms; P05's four cause rooms are in this batch. Revisiting the work that rested on QD3-010's assumption: the assumption was only that the leg stays open and nothing more changes; nothing was done under it, so nothing is revisited. The rulings of the first batch stand. Plan: G61 and its five readings govern the second batch unchanged (rules before rows); the order is the first batch's: G61 (1) repeats, reading 1's default limits, the flagged absent lines, the revised elements R01 and P05, the candidates, the standing elements and arrows, then the propose lines; each rulings file under a new name; then P05 and R01 re-examined on all 705 rooms, the notes' D3b section superseded by a full one, the head, and done.sh D3.
